Recorded claim:
The new test_addrBookDataAdapter.js contains named testSanity and testCellText tasks. It checks all versus selected directories, sorting, mailing-list row properties, and vCard cell text as values are added, reordered, and removed. The cell-text task detaches its listener tree with setTree(null) after assertions. The filename ties the test to its class module and the tasks state the behavior. This is a local test naming and cleanup example.

Provenance: 17c576427d3d34e7cebff12697a20918a34a726d34a62b9811baafecb592655b. Original evidence IDs: 758bffd13aae6ce28e862d3816acabf6b94b867e7f438ceb4a2cc60b15efd940, 93c004ff9eac8f5e2ca61acf3488d6e044d52da057a9f6b9686637d17bb36f1d, ba2865e4632b47790a6c6b4a3b5ccb4210c5088ff0799facd3eb252ac5fa5dfb.
